policy: Official repositories and datasets are pinned. Derived strata are labeled and never presented as official benchmark tasks.

sources.title: Screen Point-and-Read / Tree-of-Lens
sources.license: MIT on Hugging Face dataset card
sources.nativeEntrypoint: Repository inference code plus Hugging Face dataset
blockers: Official repository lists detailed setup inputs and evaluation scripts as TODO
Legacy DINO/MMDetection stack requires a dedicated environment

sources.title: ScreenQA
blockers: RICO image acquisition and redistribution terms must be checked

sources.title: DashboardQA
sources.license: Apache-2.0 code; dashboard/third-party asset terms require manual review
blockers: Native interactive evaluation expects an OSWorld-capable VM
DashboardQA-Ref selection annotations must be generated and independently audited

sources.title: BrowserGym
blockers: Individual benchmarks pin their own compatible BrowserGym forks or versions

sources.title: WorkArena / WorkArena++
sources.license: Apache-2.0 code; gated instance terms apply
blockers: User approval and authentication for WorkArena-Instances
ServiceNow instances/configuration
WorkArena-QA-Ref annotations must be created and audited

sources.title: WebMall
sources.license: No root license file at the pinned commit; terms unresolved
blockers: Python 3.11 or 3.12
Linux/WSL Docker Compose
Eight shop/database containers
Repository-specific BrowserGym/AgentLab submodules
WebMall-QA-Ref annotations must be created and audited

sources.title: Comparing Web Interfaces for LLM Agents
sources.license: README refers to a license file, but no root license file exists at the pinned commit; terms unresolved
blockers: Cross-benchmark RAG/MCP/NLWeb adapters are adaptations, not native replications
Fact-parity extraction audit required

sources.title: ST-WebAgentBench
sources.license: Apache license for repository code and data
blockers: WebArena GitLab and ShoppingAdmin services
SuiteCRM service and credentials
Playwright-compatible environment
Leaderboard signing key only if an official submission is desired

sources.title: Interaction-Augmented Instructions
blockers: P4 is a pre-registered operationalization, not an official runnable system

sources.title: Ferret-UI
sources.license: Apple sample-code license; Ferret-UI data and weight differentials are CC BY-NC 4.0/research-only and upstream model terms apply
blockers: Not a drop-in representation for the fixed actor table

sources.title: UI-Hawk / FunUI
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 repository; model and dataset dependencies require review
